challenges.title: An inventory with typed errors and Codable
challenges.prompt: Build an Inventory value type that receives and ships stock, throws a typed error for bad quantities, unknown items and insufficient stock, reports sorted lines and round-trips through JSON with Codable. It runs as an ordinary Swift script on your machine (swift main.swift); no UI is involved.
challenges.expected:
ok   receive apple 10
ok   receive pear 4
ok   ship apple 3
fail ship pear 9: insufficientStock(item: "pear", have: 4, want: 9)
fail ship kiwi 1: unknownItem("kiwi")
fail receive fig 0: invalidQuantity(0)
["apple: 7", "pear: 4"]
[{"quantity":7,"sku":"apple"},{"quantity":4,"sku":"pear"}]
true
challenges.explain: The guard statements validate in order, an enum with associated values carries the details, items[sku, default:] creates entries on demand and private(set) protects the invariant. Verified by running it with Swift 6.4 on macOS.

challenges.title: Parallel work with a task group, an actor cache and cancellation
challenges.prompt: Square a list of numbers concurrently with a task group, share an actor-protected cache between the child tasks, show that a long task stops when cancelled and combine two async let results. Timings are tiny sleeps so it finishes in under a second; only deterministic facts are printed.
challenges.expected:
1->1 2->4 3->9 4->16 5->25 6->36 9->81
lookups: 10 unique results: 7
cancelled early: true
113
challenges.explain: Each child task awaits the actor, so results are collected safely; hits plus misses always equals the lookups, while the split between them can vary because an awaiting actor method can be re-entered. Cancellation is cooperative: the worker checks Task.isCancelled. Verified by running it with Swift 6.4 on macOS.
